title: Carroll-Field-Jackiw term in nonlocal Lorentz-violating QED
summary: We investigate the radiative generation of the Carroll--Field--Jackiw (CFJ) term in nonlocal Lorentz- and CPT-violating extensions of quantum electrodynamics. Nonlocality is introduced in the fermionic sector through entire form factors depending on the Dirac operator. Using the Fréchet and derivative expansions of the one-loop fermionic determinant, we derive the induced CFJ contribution and analyze its ultraviolet behavior after Wick rotation.
